verdicts.quote: “OAuth integrations… use the OAuth 2.0 protocol.” and “Send the code as part of a POST request to Notion’s token endpoint: https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token.” ([developers.notion.com](https://developers.notion.com/guides/authorization/overview))
verdicts.reason: Public OAuth2 is documented and intended for multi-tenant apps; token exchange is via the standard OAuth 2.0 flow.

verdicts.quote: “You can start authorization as soon as you configure the integration’s client credentials and redirect URI; Marketplace submission or review is not required.” ([developers.notion.com](https://developers.notion.com/guides/authorization/overview))
verdicts.reason: Credentials are created self‑serve in the Developer Portal, OAuth can be used immediately without review, and Notion’s help center states the API is available to all users.

verdicts.quote: “Endpoints… Blocks • Pages • Databases • Data sources • Comments • Views • File Uploads • Search • Users • Agents • Agent Skills.” ([developers.notion.com](https://developers.notion.com/reference/create-file))
verdicts.reason: The API covers core objects with several categories, but it does not expose “full CRUD across the product” (e.g., many product areas like workspace admin, templates/marketplace, and full user/group management live in separate or limited surfaces). By the given definitions, this is better classified as moderate (core objects) rather than broad (dozens+ resources with full CRUD).

verdicts.quote: “Manual setup… The remote server URL is https://mcp.notion.com/mcp.” ([developers.notion.com](https://developers.notion.com/guides/mcp/get-started-with-mcp))
verdicts.reason: Notion documents and hosts an official MCP server at the cited URL.

verdicts.quote: “You can start authorization as soon as you configure the integration’s client credentials… Marketplace submission or review is not required.” ([developers.notion.com](https://developers.notion.com/guides/authorization/overview))
verdicts.reason: Self‑serve creds and comprehensive docs/webhooks exist; nothing material blocks Composio from shipping an agent toolkit today.
